rule1: You can register from {registrationOpenDate} until {registrationClosedDate}, or until we reach the maximum of {maxRegistration} projects. So don't wait too long.
rule2: You are between {minAge} and {maxAge} years old on the day of the event and you live in Belgium.
rule3: All projects are welcome, from beginner to advanced, in any technology. Not quite finished? No problem.
rule4: After you register, you receive a confirmation email. Click the link to confirm your registration.
rule5: You can work with up to 4 participants on one project. The project owner registers the project first and sends the team members an invitation email with a registration token. Each team member then registers separately using that token.
rule6: For a valid entry, you send in 3 to 5 photos of your project, at the latest on {projectClosedDate} at 23:59.
rule7: After you register, you update your own personal details. Only the project owner can change the project information. Everything must be final by {projectClosedDate}, because that is when we close.
rule8: We expect you on {officialStartDate} at Technopolis in Mechelen to present your project with your team.
rule9: Anyone who presents their project on {officialStartDate} receives a goodie.
rule10a: a. All personal data we collect are required for us to organize the event. These personal data, with the exemption of the email address of the guardian or +16-year-old participant and the year of participation, will be removed from our systems 6 months after the end date of the event. Aggregated data, void from personal data, are kept for statistical and reporting purposes.
rule10b: b. By registering for Coolest Projects, you agree that we can use your project data and pictures on our website and social media for promoting future events.
rule10d: (For additional information, you can consult our privacy statement on the CoderDojo Belgium website {privacy_link}.)
